summary: Backend: 25/26 pytest passing against public preview URL. 1 failure — Stripe checkout returns 400 'Invalid API Key provided: sk_test_****gent' because backend uses raw `stripe` SDK; the `sk_test_emergent` key only works through `emergentintegrations.payments.stripe` (module is installed at /root/.venv/.../emergentintegrations/payments/stripe/). All other endpoints work: JWT signup/signin/me, onboarding (persistence verified via GET /auth/me), emotions/meditations (all + filter + by id + 404), prayers (list + filter), devotional, mood log+history, journal create+list, meditation completion (minutes_meditated increments correctly), AI prayer (GPT-5.2 via emergentintegrations produced full ~140-word scripture-anchored prayer ending in 'Amen'), subscription/status returns active=false for fresh user, checkout invalid-plan returns 400. Auth guards work (401 without token). Frontend: All 15 flows PASS on mobile viewport (390x844) — onboarding shell + skip-to-signin, JWT sign-in with token persistence, home (greeting/SOS/emotion chips/devotional/AI CTA/upgrade), SOS breathing screen with scripture, emotion chip → /meditate?emotion=anxious filter, meditation player, prayers tab with category chips + cards, journal (created 'TEST journal entry from playwright' and it appears in Past Entries), profile with stats grid + menu, AI Prayer end-to-end (generated real prayer via LLM in ~15s), paywall UI (plan toggle + subscribe), sign-out returns to /sign-in. Paywall subscribe click triggers the Stripe 400 above and silently fails on frontend (no user-facing error toast/banner shown). No React Native red screens, no deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch usage detected.

critical.issue: Returns 400 'Invalid API Key provided: sk_test_****gent'. Backend uses raw `stripe` SDK (import stripe; stripe.api_key=...; stripe.checkout.Session.create) but `sk_test_emergent` is an Emergent-managed placeholder that only routes through the `emergentintegrations.payments.stripe` module. Migrate the checkout endpoint (and /api/stripe/verify/{session_id}) to use `from emergentintegrations.payments.stripe import ...` instead of the raw stripe SDK. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:391-411 and :435.

minor.issue: Backend lowercases email server-side (correct) but does not document this in the response schema. User client-side may still show original case; consider echoing back the normalized email so UI matches. Not a bug, purely informational.

ui_bugs.issue: When Stripe checkout returns 400, the frontend silently stays on the paywall with no error banner/toast. User has no feedback that subscription failed. Add try/catch with visible error state on paywall-subscribe-btn.

integration_issues.issue: Blocked by backend Stripe integration (see backend critical). Frontend correctly posts {plan, origin_url} and expects {url}. Once backend is migrated to emergentintegrations, frontend should redirect to `data.url` via Linking.openURL (verify implementation in app/paywall.tsx).

rca_of_issue: Stripe 400: server.py imports the raw `stripe` python SDK and calls `stripe.checkout.Session.create(...)` directly against api.stripe.com using STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_test_emergent. Stripe's real API rejects this key as invalid. The `sk_test_emergent` string is not a real Stripe secret — it is an Emergent-provided placeholder that is only recognized by the internal `emergentintegrations.payments.stripe` module (already installed in the venv). Fix: replace direct `stripe.checkout.Session.create` calls with the emergent stripe module's checkout session builder (same signature — mode/line_items/success_url/cancel_url/metadata/customer_email — but routed through the Emergent proxy). Reproduction: `curl -X POST $EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL/api/stripe/checkout -H 'Authorization: Bearer <jwt>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"plan":"monthly","origin_url":"https://calm-faith-app-2.preview.emergentagent.com"}'` → returns 400 with body `{"detail":"Invalid API Key provided: sk_test_****gent"}`.
